pages.title: Purpose
pages.text: Normal logs cannot be stored in chests, but they can be placed on the ground instead: each block holds up to 16 logs, and different kinds of logs can be combined. Look at the model change or Jade to see how many logs are stacked.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Hold a log and sneak-right-click the ground to place a log pile, or sneak-right-click an existing pile to keep adding logs. A normal right-click puts one log into the pile, a sneak-right-click puts in a whole stack at once, and a full pile stacks upward automatically. With an empty hand, a normal right-click takes one log out, and a sneak-right-click takes the whole top stack at once. All ArborFirmaCraft (AFC) logs and ancient woods are supported.
